key_insight: ALLMTS grounds LLM-based triage in executable clinical guidelines, achieving 95% accuracy versus 47% for a raw-LLM baseline on synthetic scenarios.
clinical_relevance: Guideline-based automation could support more consistent, auditable telephone triage while reducing unnecessary escalation.
method: Selects a commercially maintained telehealth guideline from an intake note.
Uses an LLM to evaluate the guideline’s triage assessment questions.
Determines disposition using the guideline’s first-positive-answer traversal rule.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 566 synthetic, expert-validated scenarios across 14 dispositions; on a curated 50-scenario subset, accuracy was 98% versus 94.4% for a five-nurse panel.
watch_item: Synthetic-scenario results do not establish real-world safety; prospective validation is needed before clinical deployment.
paper_title: ALLMTS: Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System
